verdict.line: You lose if you walk autos into an active W (Riposte) and get out-traded point-blank; you win if you poke with Q (Corrosive Charge) from 800 range and only commit E (Disdain) once Fiora's double Lunge is spent.

brief.thesis: Urgot is the only ranged kit in this lane — Q (800 range) and E (475 range) both outreach every Fiora tool except her Q (Lunge, 600 range) — and his W (Purge) cooldown collapses from 12s to 0s as it ranks, turning him into a near-permanent DPS check that an all-melee dash kit can't out-trade late. That structural gap is why a lane OP.GG calls EVEN on paper still returns a 53.1% Urgot win rate over 1211 games, slightly ahead of his 51% baseline across 57,935 games.

theirWindow.what: If her parry is available and she's mid Burst of Speed (E), she's actively hunting an auto-attack trade and gaining move speed off every hit she lands — don't feed her the parry, and don't try to walk away from a stacking speed buff.

yourWindow.what: Lunge can be recast within a couple seconds for free, but once both charges are used she has no gap-closer until the 16/14/12/10/8s cooldown refreshes — this is when E (Disdain) to hurl her away or a straight Purge trade is safe.

start.why: The measured favorite at 51.6% over 1218 games (85.4% pick) — sustain plus damage to win early auto trades before your W cooldown drops.

boots.why: 52.5% over 1013 games (74.7% pick); her Duelist passive stacks off basic attacks, so flat auto-damage reduction blunts her sustain engine directly.

core.why: Stacking armor shred rewards landing repeated hits with Purge's multi-trigger kit, and the haste loops Q/E/W faster.
Health and AD scaling to survive a double-Lunge all-in or a Blade Waltz reset chain without dying to burst.

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking vulnerability debuff rewards Purge's rapid multi-hit ticks against a single melee target, turning extended trades into bonus damage windows.

summoners.why: The measured favorite at 52.4% win rate and 85.5% pick rate; Ignite secures kills once R (Fear Beyond Death) drops her below the execute threshold before Duelist regen can heal her back out, and Flash dodges her double Lunge (Q) engage or disengages from a stacking Burst of Speed (E).

playing.title: Poke from 800 range
playing.detail: Q (Corrosive Charge) outranges every Fiora tool including her Q (Lunge, 600 range) — throw it whenever she steps forward to farm.

playing.title: Hold autos on her Riposte
playing.detail: W (Riposte, CD 10/9/8/7/6s) parries your next basic attack and reflects damage; if it's up, land Q/E instead of walking an auto into it.

playing.title: Punish after double Lunge
playing.detail: Her Q recasts free within a couple seconds, but once both charges are gone she has no gap-closer until the cooldown resets — step up with E (Disdain) or trade freely here.

playing.title: Spam Purge once ranked
playing.detail: W's cooldown drops from 12s to 3s by rank 4; once you're there, use it on cooldown for wave clear and trade damage instead of saving it.

playing.title: Hurl her off your tower
playing.detail: E (Disdain) stops on the first champion it hits and throws them past you — use it to fling Fiora away from your plates before committing further, not just to close distance.

playing.title: Pair R with antiheal
playing.detail: R (Fear Beyond Death, CD 100/85/70s) only executes below a health threshold; land it alongside Ignite or Executioner's Calling so Duelist regen can't pull her back out of range.

playing.title: Don't chase a sped-up Fiora
playing.detail: Every attack or Lunge she lands during Burst of Speed (E) adds move speed — if she's mid-E, disengage rather than trying to outrun a stacking speed buff.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample figures above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning, timing windows, and trade-pattern advice are my own tactical read on top of that data.
